description: This file implements the core logic for the 'git bisect' command, including starting, updating, resetting, and tracking bisect status. It defines functions for managing bisect terms, performing revision walks, executing commands, and handling bisect states, along with command dispatch routines.

methods.name: void set_terms(struct bisect_terms * terms,const char * bad,const char * good)
methods.description: Sets the bisect terms 'good' and 'bad' to specified values.

methods.name: void free_terms(struct bisect_terms * terms)
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for bisect terms.

methods.name: int write_terms(const char * bad,const char * good)
methods.description: Writes the current bisect terms to the terms file.

methods.name: int bisect_reset(const char * commit)
methods.description: Resets the bisect state to a clean state, optionally checking out a specific commit.

methods.name: void log_commit(FILE * fp,const char * fmt,const char * state,struct commit * commit)
methods.description: Logs details of a commit to a file for bisect purposes.

methods.name: int bisect_write(const char * state,const char * rev,const struct bisect_terms * terms,int nolog)
methods.description: Updates refs and logs for a given bisect state ('good', 'bad', or 'skip').

methods.name: int check_term_format(const char * term,const char * orig_term)
methods.description: Validates the format of a bisect term.

methods.name: int check_and_set_terms(struct bisect_terms * terms,const char * cmd)
methods.description: Checks validity and potentially updates the bisect terms based on commands.

methods.name: int decide_next(const struct bisect_terms * terms,const char * current_term,int missing_good,int missing_bad)
methods.description: Decides the next bisect step based on current terms and state.

methods.name: void bisect_status(struct bisect_state * state,const struct bisect_terms * terms)
methods.description: Displays current bisect status based on references.

methods.name: void bisect_log_printf(const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Appends a formatted message to the bisect log.

methods.name: void bisect_print_status(const struct bisect_terms * terms)
methods.description: Prints the bisect status messages.

methods.name: int get_terms(struct bisect_terms * terms)
methods.description: Reads the current bisect terms from the storage.

methods.name: int bisect_terms(struct bisect_terms * terms,const char * option)
methods.description: Handles the 'terms' command for displaying or setting bisect terms.

methods.name: int bisect_append_log_quoted(const char ** argv)
methods.description: Appends the current command arguments to the bisect log with quoting.

methods.name: int add_bisect_ref(const struct reference * ref,void * cb)
methods.description: Callback to add a reference to the revision set for bisect.

methods.name: int prepare_revs(struct bisect_terms * terms,struct rev_info * revs)
methods.description: Prepares revision set for bisecting based on terms.

methods.name: int bisect_skipped_commits(struct bisect_terms * terms)
methods.description: Logs skipped commits during bisect.

methods.name: int bisect_successful(struct bisect_terms * terms)
methods.description: Marks the first bad commit upon successful bisect.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error bisect_next(struct bisect_terms * terms,const char * prefix)
methods.description: Performs computation to decide the next bisect revision.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error bisect_auto_next(struct bisect_terms * terms,const char * prefix)
methods.description: Automatically advances to next bisect revision if possible.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error bisect_start(struct bisect_terms * terms,int argc,const char ** argv)
methods.description: Initializes a bisect session with given terms and revisions.

methods.name: int file_is_not_empty(const char * path)
methods.description: Checks if a file is present and not empty.

methods.name: int bisect_autostart(struct bisect_terms * terms)
methods.description: Starts bisecting automatically when required.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error bisect_state(struct bisect_terms * terms,int argc,const char ** argv)
methods.description: Processes commands related to bisect state changes.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error bisect_log(void)
methods.description: Outputs the bisect log contents.

methods.name: int process_replay_line(struct bisect_terms * terms,struct strbuf * line)
methods.description: Processes a line in a bisect replay log to restore state.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error bisect_replay(struct bisect_terms * terms,const char * filename)
methods.description: Replays a bisect log to restore bisect state.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error bisect_skip(struct bisect_terms * terms,int argc,const char ** argv)
methods.description: Marks certain revisions as skipped during bisect.

methods.name: int bisect_visualize(struct bisect_terms * terms,int argc,const char ** argv)
methods.description: Visualizes current bisect state using external tools.

methods.name: int get_first_good(const struct reference * ref,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Callback to get the first good revision reference.

methods.name: int do_bisect_run(const char * command)
methods.description: Runs an external command as part of bisect testing.

methods.name: int verify_good(const struct bisect_terms * terms,const char * command)
methods.description: Verifies that a specified revision is good.

methods.name: int bisect_run(struct bisect_terms * terms,int argc,const char ** argv)
methods.description: Performs a bisect run with command execution.
